# MotusDAO

> MotusDAO es una infraestructura clínica, comunitaria y tecnológica para construir redes vivas de cuidado en salud mental. Integra privacidad por diseño, coordinación distribuida, educación clínica y herramientas de cuidado híbrido humano–IA.

## Main

- [Home](https://www.motusdao.org/): Manifesto and product gateway
- [Explore ecosystem](https://www.motusdao.org/#explora): Users · Professionals · Community/Investors
- [Network invariants](https://www.motusdao.org/#invariantes): Stable surfaces of the living network
- [FAQ](https://www.motusdao.org/#faq): Extractable Q&A
- [3D map](https://www.motusdao.org/#ecosistema-3d): Optional interactive explorer

## Network invariants

- [Wellness Hub](https://app.motusdao.org/): Primary care and practice application
- [Academia](https://app.motusdao.org/academia): Professional training
- [PsyChat / MotusAI](https://chat.motusdao.org/): Hybrid conversational surface (does not replace clinical judgment)
- [Metaverso](https://metaverso.motusdao.org/): Immersive community spaces
- [Agents](https://agents.motusdao.org/): Agent layer for coordination and network operations

## Machine

- [ecosystem.json](https://www.motusdao.org/ecosystem.json): Machine-readable surface catalog
- [Motus Knowledge MCP](https://mcp.motusdao.org/mcp): Grounded MotusDAO documentation for agents

## Notes

- Clinical judgment remains with licensed professionals.
- MotusDAO does not guarantee patients, income, or clinical outcomes.
